title: OSIsoft PI Server 2017
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER AUTHENTICATION CWE-287 PI Data Archive has protocol flaws with the potential to expose change records in the clear and allow a malicious party to spoof a server within a collective. CVE-2017-7930 has been assigned to this vulnerability. OSIsoft calculated a CVSS v3 base score of 8.9; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L ). IMPROPER AUTHENTICATION CWE-287 PI Network Manager using older protocol versions contains a flaw that could allow a malicious user to authenticate with a server and then cause PI Network Manager to behave in an undefined manner. CVE-2017-7934 has been assigned to this vulnerability. OSIsoft calculated a CVSS v3 base score of 5.9; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ). RESEARCHER OSIsoft self-disclosed these vulnerabilities.
